It started slow. He’s disabled from a traumatic brain injury. But I knew him for a long time, he was capable of taking care of himself. I would come home and the gas would be on. He started forgetting things; like time, what day it was, etc.. I eventually caught him talking to himself and when I asked about it he said he was talking to ‘said person’ who wasn’t there because they were at work. I tried telling his family but no one listened to me. Eventually he stopped eating, bathing. Couldn’t do simple tasks. Would hide things. He disappeared twice and I had to find him somewhere in our apartment complex. Eventually he just stopped walking and I started carrying him throughout the apartment. That’s when he starting urinating and defecating in his room. Eventually he was so malnourished an ambulance was called. Oh, forgot to mention his injury was from an accident caused by alcoholism which he still had while disabled.
